faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: It's designed primarily for children and teenagers aged 5 to 17. However, many adults have told us they also learn a lot from the basics.
faq.q2: Is it safe for my children?
faq.a2: Absolutely. There's no open chat with strangers, no external advertising, and all data is encrypted.
faq.a3: We're currently in a Free Open Beta. You can register and use all features at no cost. In the future we'll have premium plans, but there will always be a free tier.
faq.q4: Do I need to supervise my child while they play?
faq.a4: It's not necessary, the platform is self-guided. However, we have a "Parent Dashboard" where you can see their progress and we give you tips to discuss what they learned.
faq.contact_title: Didn't find what you're looking for?
faq.contact_subtitle: We'd love to hear your questions, feedback, or suggestions. Reach out to us directly.

task_manager.title: Have Your Child Earn Coins for Tasks
task_manager.description: The heart of the family model. Define tasks (clean room, make bed, study), assign virtual LittleFounders coin rewards, and watch your child complete them motivated by tangible goals. Tasks can align with financial lessons to reinforce concepts.
task_manager.feature_1: Create custom tasks with coins as rewards
task_manager.feature_2: Set deadlines and priorities for each task
task_manager.feature_3: Monitor status in real-time and receive notifications
task_manager.feature_4: Integrate LittleFounders lessons as special tasks
task_manager.benefit_1_desc: Virtual coins are concrete goals your kids can see grow. It's not theory, it's a reward system that actually works.
task_manager.benefit_2_desc: Each completed task reinforces autonomy and discipline skills. Your child learns that actions have real consequences.
task_manager.benefit_3_desc: Set the value of each task based on difficulty and financial education. More complex tasks = more coins.
task_manager.benefit_4_desc: A transparent panel where your child sees their task history and coins earned over time.

mock_data.conversation_text: {{child_name}} learned about {{topic}}. Ask them: if you had $100, how would you split it?

marketplace.title: Redeem Coins for Real Rewards
marketplace.description: The coins your child earns aren't just numbers. In the Marketplace, they can redeem them for rewards they actually want: real pocket money, premium content access, special items, or family experiences. This closes the loop: work → money → smart purchase.
marketplace.item_1_desc: Convert virtual coins into real cash or bank transfers so your child learns to spend responsibly.
marketplace.item_2_desc: Unlock new games, advanced lessons, or premium AI tutor with their earned coins.
marketplace.item_3_desc: Define your own rewards: extra screen time, special outing, or whatever motivates your child.

parent_tools.title: Monitor, Teach, and Prepare Your Child
parent_tools.description: Beyond assigning tasks, we have a complete parent panel. Visualize your child's financial progress, receive conversation recommendations about money, and access educational guides to deepen concepts your child is learning on the platform.
parent_tools.feature_1: Visual dashboard with key progress metrics
parent_tools.feature_2: Guided conversations about money and investing
parent_tools.insight_1_desc: Intuitive charts show tasks completed, money saved, and financial skills developed.
parent_tools.insight_2_desc: Observe how your child spends their coins. Are they saving for something big? Spending immediately? These patterns reveal financial mindset.
parent_tools.insight_3_desc: Weekly prompts: 'This week your child learned about debt, ask them...'. You become a tutor without trying.
parent_tools.insight_4_desc: Full control over which tasks your child sees, spending limits, and who can redeem rewards.
parent_tools.insight_5_desc: At month's end, get a report: concepts learned, skills developed, areas to dive deeper.
parent_tools.insight_6_desc: Shared family achievements: complete 50 tasks together in a month, unlock group rewards.

benefits.title: A Tool That Works for Everyone
benefits.description: It's not a game to leave your child alone. It's a family tool that brings you closer while teaching real financial values in a way you never thought possible.
benefits.benefit_1_desc: No boring lectures. Your child sees tasks as earning opportunities, not punishments. Money conversations become natural.
benefits.benefit_2_desc: Your child learns to work, save, budget, and exchange resources. Skills they'll carry into adulthood.
benefits.benefit_3_desc: Your child makes money decisions in a safe environment. They fail with virtual coins, not in the real world.
benefits.benefit_4_desc: Tasks and money are excuses to connect, converse, and align on values as a family.
